scene_report.description: V2 of Klothys's Titan prison: no repeated face reliefs. Two CC0 animated fantasy creature bodies are baked from rigged sources, radially wrapped into carbonite-like stone reliefs and embedded into the exact 220 m Godot sphere. A +/-28 degree front corridor is kept clear for the later Klothys figure and her binding hair.
design_references: User-approved concept: two full creature silhouettes imprisoned in a cracked runic stone sphere
